entities.summary: Hiroshi Miyamura was a United States Army soldier and a recipient of the Medal of Honor, the United States military's highest award for valor, for his actions during the Korean War. He was one of the last three surviving Medal of Honor recipients of the Korean War, along with Ralph Puckett Jr. and Royce Williams. While he was held as a prisoner of war, the award was classified as top secret.
